verify.name: compile check
verify.command: python3 -m compileall -q core demo.py tests scripts

verify.name: cli smoke (doctor/run/verify/replay)
verify.command: rm -rf .ci-sandbox && python3 -m core doctor --sandbox .ci-sandbox --json > /dev/null && python3 -m core run --sandbox .ci-sandbox --goal-type create_file --param path=ci.txt --param content=ci --json > /dev/null && python3 -m core verify --sandbox .ci-sandbox --json > /dev/null && python3 -m core replay --sandbox .ci-sandbox --json > /dev/null && rm -rf .ci-sandbox
